scope.scenario: The retry fixture performs an allowed 4,096-byte replacement, refuses a 4,097-byte retry, reads back the preserved candidate, and completes. The new case sets AcpFilesystemLimits.maximumWriteBytes to 4,096 while maximumPatchBytes is 8,192 and all other applicable repair budgets have headroom, isolating the ACP filesystem callback byte ceiling. The existing sibling control instead sets maximumPatchBytes to 4,096 while the ACP filesystem write limit remains 8 MiB.
scope.candidate: The active validator receives the exact 4,096-byte MODIFIED candidate and then throws the expected sentinel. The durable receipt records allowed write, denied resource-limit write, and allowed readback; the rejected assessment binds the receipt and candidate digest. Accepted source and graph head remain unchanged, pending state is cleared, and process/sandbox cleanup is verified.
